ideas.pitch: An open-source documentation assistant that automatically generates interactive code playgrounds for React and Node repositories.
ideas.title: OpenDocs AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the open-source spirit of Geekhaven's OpenCode, this appeals directly to maintainers who struggle with outdated documentation, fitting the developer tools ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI commit message and code smell reviewer tailored for student open-source contributors.
ideas.title: CommitCoach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the exact friction new open-source contributors face when making their first pull requests, making it instantly relatable to hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that converts Figma typography and wireframe components directly into functional Flutter skeleton code.
ideas.title: FlutterFlow Wireframe Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges the gap between design and app development tracks, solving a common solo-developer bottleneck during 24-hour sprints.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight automated vulnerability scanner for Spring Boot dependency trees leveraging local LLaMA models for remediation advice.
ideas.title: SpringGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses cybersecurity and enterprise backend development standards using cutting-edge local AI models, demonstrating deep technical competence.

ideas.pitch: An open-source asset license and metadata validator plugin for Unity to prevent copyright and dependency issues in indie games.
ideas.title: UnityAssetSentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the niche game development track with a practical utility tool that game studios and independent developers desperately need.
